scope: Seven normal, fatal and syntax-diagnostic source inputs compare exact status/stdout/stderr with pinned GNU. The debug one-line reader is included. Valgrind checks both parser-owned cleanup and preservation of inherited stdin and an unrelated open data descriptor. No suppressions. Separate track-fds=all inspection intentionally reports the four inherited descriptors as four errors; strict track-fds=yes memory runs must have zero errors.
